sentences.en: This invention was the result of years of patient experiment.
sentences.zh: 这项发明是多年耐心实验的结果。

sentences.en: In early times, inventions were often stumbled upon by accident.
sentences.zh: 在早期时代，许多发明往往是偶然发现的。

sentences.en: This invention of his proved to be of great value.
sentences.zh: 他的这个发明证明具有巨大的价值。

senses.zh: 发明,发明物,捏造：内心捏造的东西，特指谎言,发明才能
